segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: Thanks for coming in. To start, what are you hoping to achieve with this money?

segments.speaker: CLIENT
segments.text: Mainly to build a house deposit. I've got about £7,500 to put in.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: And what sort of timeframe are you working to?

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: How would you feel if the value fell noticeably in a bad year?

segments.speaker: CLIENT
segments.text: some ups and downs are fine for better growth.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: If you did lose some of this money, how would it affect your day-to-day finances?

segments.speaker: CLIENT
segments.text: I honestly haven't thought about it. Not sure.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: Understood — something for us to firm up.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: Have you invested before, or mostly cash savings?

segments.speaker: CLIENT
segments.text: Mostly cash savings, pension; I trade rarely.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: Income and outgoings — roughly £42,300 a year and £2,600 essential monthly costs, is that right?

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.text: Thanks. I'll review this and set out my recommendation in writing before anything proceeds.
